## Earnie 2.6.1-beta.1

Community **pre-release** (hotfix line from **2.6.0**). Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **[#24](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/issues/24) hourly Gesamt-CSV:** Path B residual holds hourly power across 15‑min slots (ZOH via `csv_kw_at_datetime`) instead of quartering energy
- **[#24](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/issues/24) HA tariffs path:** add-on sidecars stay under `EARNIE_CONFIG_PATH` (`/config`); no fallback to a stale `/data/earnie_env/config/tariffs.json`
- **Catalog:** remove plant-date-dependent EEG fixed feed-in row — use **Eigener Festpreis** for site-specific rates
- **Versioning:** allow SemVer pre-release label `beta.N` (alongside alpha/rc)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.1-beta.1` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`) after you approve **promote**
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.6.0**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
